title: Britain Sanctions Sudanese Commanders Over Weaponised Rape
detail: The United Kingdom announced sanctions on Sudanese commanders over the use of rape and sexual violence as a weapon of war, per Al Jazeera.

media.caption: Britain sanctions Sudanese commanders over weaponised rape

title: Paramilitary Drone Strikes Cause Mass Power Cuts in Eastern Sudan
detail: Drone strikes attributed to the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces caused widespread power outages across eastern Sudanese states, per a news report aggregated via Google News.
